# Guagua Tools

> A free, lightweight collection of browser tools for developers, AI agent users, and creators.

- Privacy: https://guagua-alvin.top/privacy

- AI agent tools collection: https://guagua-alvin.top/ai-agent-tools
- Expert agent blueprint library: https://guagua-alvin.top/agents/
- Agent plugin download catalog: https://guagua-alvin.top/downloads/agent-plugins.json
- Web utilities collection: https://guagua-alvin.top/web-utilities
- PrintSpec Lab: https://printspeclab.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP Config Lab: https://mcp.guagua-alvin.top/

## Guides

- All guides: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/
- Where every MCP client keeps its config file: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/mcp-config-file-locations
- Fix an MCP server that will not connect: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/mcp-server-not-connecting
- MCP transports: stdio, Streamable HTTP and the old SSE transport: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/mcp-stdio-vs-streamable-http
- Convert a Claude Desktop MCP config to Codex TOML: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/claude-mcp-to-codex
- Fix an MCP OAuth 401 from the first broken link: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/debug-mcp-oauth-401
- Fix an MCP App that opens as a blank panel: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/fix-mcp-app-blank-ui
- Find why an MCP Task never leaves "working": https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/debug-mcp-task-polling
- Migrate an MCP server to the stateless 2026-07-28 protocol: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/migrate-mcp-2026
- Publish an MCP server to the official MCP Registry: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/publish-mcp-registry-server
- Control AI crawlers with robots.txt and Content-Signal: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/block-ai-crawlers-robots-txt
- Write an AGENTS.md that coding agents actually follow: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/write-agents-md
- How many pixels you need to print at 300 DPI: https://guagua-alvin.top/guides/image-resolution-for-print

The directory requires no account. Individual tools describe their own local-processing and privacy boundaries.
